lib/teeJson.ts: parse isinya (lebih ketat daripada percaya header), dengan
penjagaan khusus untuk halaman HTML interstitial.

- Plafon deposit follower dijelaskan: `maxDeposit` follower NOL di vault yang

- Baris "Strategist co-investment" masuk daftar guardrail.

strategi (G5), dan ditahan aturan co-investment. Menggabungkan dua yang
terakhir membuat strategist menunggu peristiwa yang tidak akan pernah datang.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add a README to the repository root

The repository has been public since this morning with no README. Anyone
opening it — including a judge following the submission — landed on a file
listing with no explanation of what the project is or where to look.

This promotes the submission draft, rewritten for an outside reader: the
BLOCKED_USER markers were internal tracker language and are replaced by plain
statements of what is and is not done. Relative links are rebased to the root
and checked. The status table now says the deployment is live and names the two
things that are not: the demo video and the internal pilot.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Record the indicator-driven trade and the first follower deposit

The EMA vault stayed silent through 32 consecutive evaluations and signed on
the 33rd, when XRP/USD actually reversed. That silence is what makes it
evidence: a price threshold fires immediately or never, and is recoverable from
a single trade. Parameters were never tuned to guarantee a trigger — the second
vault, with a tighter pair, went 60 attempts without firing.

A follower deposit also appeared from an address that is neither the
strategist, the keeper, nor the proxy wallet. The submission copy said no
follower had deposited; that is now corrected, and marked as a real deposit
rather than traction or a pilot.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add a tighter EMA pair as a second live-proof attempt

A 60/300 crossover needs a genuine trend reversal, and XRP/USD spent the
evaluation window drifting in one direction. The 60/120 pair reacts to smaller
moves, so it crosses more often — a normal scalping choice, not a thumb on the
scale. Direction is crossesBelow, an exit-on-weakness rule, which suits the
regime the feed has actually been in.

Both vaults report indicatorReadiness ready with 389 samples over a 3654 second
observed span. What is left is the crossing itself, which is a market event and
cannot be scheduled.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Let run-test seal an arbitrary rule/v2 document

The only on-chain smoke test in the repo could seal exactly two strategies:
sell_above and buy_below. That is why the indicator layer has never been proven
against the chain — there was no way to put an EMA document in front of the
enclave without rewriting the seal, poke, and relay path by hand.

-specFile loads a rules document verbatim; version, vault, and runtime are
still filled in by the tool, so the file only carries the strategy. The first
document to use it is testdata/ema-crossover.json: a fast EMA crossing a slow
one, which is the shape a price threshold cannot imitate.

This matters beyond convenience. sell_above is precisely the defect A8 exists
to fix — a stateless threshold recoverable from one trade and the feed. A demo
that only ever fires that rule demonstrates the problem while claiming the
solution.

Verified against the live enclave: strategy sealed, runtimes ["rule/v2"],
indicatorReadiness "ready" with 390 samples and an observed span of 3637s
against a required 300s. The crossing itself is a market event and is still
being waited on.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Point every document and default at the live deployment

The docs still described the 28 July generation as current. That has misled
several sessions: a reader following CLAUDE.md would have used a retired
factory, a retired sender, and a demo vault that has been DEAD_TEE for days.

- CLAUDE.md now opens with the deployment that is actually live, plus the two
  rules that matter for an enclave sharing a box with another product: any
  container recreate rotates the machine key, and /info hides that rotation
  behind a Redis cache.
- The 28 July addresses are removed rather than relabelled. What was worth
  keeping from that generation — one real relayed trade, and the deliberate
  mixed final balance that shows the strategy moving assets while withdrawal
  stays open — is kept as prose without the numbers that invited copy-paste.
- Dated ops snapshots and runbooks get a superseded banner instead of edits.
  They were correct when written; rewriting them would destroy the record.
- frontend EXT_PROXY_URL defaulted to the dead ngrok host, so a deploy missing
  NEXT_PUBLIC_EXT_PROXY_URL would silently point at nothing. Now defaults to
  the live enclave.
- Submission package carries real addresses, the Golden Flow transaction, and
  the binary hash. Follower deposit, withdrawal, video, and the two-person
  pilot stay marked unfinished, because filling in proof is exactly when prose
  starts claiming more than the proof covers.
- G4 re-audit over the filled documents: no rejected claim returned.

Verified: contracts 112 passed 0 skipped, keeper green, frontend lint and
tsc clean, forge fmt clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Lower the Coston2 RPC rate limit to survive shared runner IPs

Serialising the suite cut the 429 failures from four to one, and the survivor
was the pool-reserve read added in the previous commit. GitHub runners share
egress IPs against the same public Flare endpoint, so 50 compute units per
second is still too eager there even with one test at a time.

Down to 25 CU/s with more patient retries. The limit is per provider, so it
only binds while the suite runs serially — the two settings have to stay
together, and each now says so where it lives.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Pin the CI forge version and explain why serial fork tests are needed

Two causes of the same red build.

forge fmt changes its rules between releases, and the CI toolchain tracked
latest while this machine ran 1.3.5. The result was CI rejecting formatting
that forge itself had just produced locally — a failure with nothing wrong in
the code. Both jobs now pin v1.7.1, the version this repo is formatted with,
so the toolchain stops being a moving input like the action refs and base
image already were.

The -j 1 comment was also wrong about the mechanism. foundry.toml already
throttles the coston2 alias with compute_units_per_second = 50, but that limit
is per provider, and every fork test opens its own. Six in parallel multiply
the rate until the public RPC answers 429, which surfaces as "EVM error;
database error: Max retries exceeded". Serial execution makes the existing
limit actually bind.

Verified with forge 1.7.1: 112 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; fmt clean;
codesizes unchanged (VaultDeployer 23,727 B, margin 849 B).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Run contract fork tests serially to stop RPC rate-limit failures

The contracts job has been red on CI for days with four fork tests failing as
"EVM error; database error: Max retries exceeded HTTP error 429". That reads
like a contract bug and is not one: six fork tests hit the public Coston2 RPC
at once from GitHub runners that share an egress IP, and the endpoint throttles
them.

-j 1 serialises the suite. It costs about two minutes and removes a failure
class that carries no information about our code. --fork-retries and
--fork-retry-backoff are not usable here: both require a global --fork-url,
while this suite creates its forks through vm.createSelectFork.

Verified locally at -j 1: 112 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Scale the fork slippage test to actual pool depth

Deepening the FXRP/USDT0 pool 5x (5 -> 25 FXRP) broke
test_fork_executeTrade_slippage_rejectsOrderTooLargeForPool, which hardcoded a
0.5 FXRP order on the premise that it was "~10% of the pool". At 25 FXRP that
order is ~2% of depth, its slippage is unremarkable, and the test failed with
"next call did not revert as expected" — a misleading red, since the product
had improved.

Price impact on an AMM is a function of the ratio, not of any absolute size, so
the test now derives the order from the live reserve: 20% of pool FXRP trips the
500 bps guardrail at any depth. The suite's maxOrderIn is raised accordingly,
because the old 1 FXRP ceiling now cuts the order off before the slippage check
runs; that ceiling has its own coverage in SealedVault.t.sol.

112/112 contract tests pass, 0 skipped, against the live Coston2 pool.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Redact shared Flare infrastructure and fix the proxy image build

The repository is public, so the indexer host and username were doing real
work for an attacker: together with a password they are the whole credential,
and the password for one of these accounts had already been exposed from this
repo. Coordinates now live only in the hackathon Telegram and on the machine
that runs the proxy, where the config file is gitignored.

- Redact indexer host and username from CLAUDE.md, PLAN.md, and three
  extension docs; replace with placeholders plus where to obtain them.
- Drop question 1 from the devops draft: the pinned Telegram message already
  states that SIMULATED_TEE on Coston2 is fine for judging and Confidential
  Space is not required. Asking it would signal we had not read the message
  that tells everyone to read it first. What remains is how to evidence which
  binary runs, and whether devops-hosted proxying is available to participants.
- Fix proxy/Dockerfile: upstream moved config.example.toml into config/ on the
  develop branch, which failed the build with a cache-key error.
- Record that the binary hash is reproducible across three hosts and two build
  epochs, so verifiers need not match our SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and that the
  Sigstore attestation validates a locally built binary.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Harden repo for public visibility and add binary provenance

The repository went public on 2026-08-06 while the pre-publication audit was
still open, so this closes the exposures that were live at that moment and adds
the evidence chain a judge needs to check what the enclave runs.

- Redact the indexer credential from TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT.md and remove the
  upstream fce-sign dev-key defaults from three locations. Both values are to
  be treated as compromised and rotated; deleting them from HEAD does not undo
  a public history.
- Fail closed instead of defaulting: docker-compose and start-services now
  refuse to start without PROXY_PRIVATE_KEY. A stack that silently comes up on
  a publicly known key is worse than one that will not start.
- Pin 12 CI action refs and the distroless base to digests. Mutable refs became
  a real attack surface once outside pull requests could trigger CI.
- Broaden gitignore by shape rather than by filename: key material, mnemonics,
  cloud credentials, editor backups, archives. Backups were the gap that
  mattered, since docker-compose.yaml.bak escapes the .env* pattern.
- Measure the enclave binary at startup and sign the hash with the TEE machine
  key. This is a claim bound to an on-chain identity, not a measurement, and
  PROTOCOL.md section 6 says so explicitly.
- Add the attestation workflow, the verifier script, and the disclosure copy
  that states which link in the chain requires trusting the operator.

Verified: 189 Go tests pass across 11 packages, go vet and gofmt clean, both
workflows parse, and two clean --no-cache builds produced a byte-identical
binary while image digests differed.

feat(frontend): G5, UI withdraw yang jujur soal porsi likuid

`maxWithdraw` di kontrak dibatasi FXRP idle, bukan NAV. Selama vault
memegang USDT0 dari posisi terbuka, sebagian nilai pemegang share tidak
bisa keluar sampai strategi memutuskan unwind — dan ia tidak bisa
memicunya MAUPUN membacanya, karena strateginya tersegel. UI menampilkan
satu angka saldo, jadi ia menjanjikan pintu keluar yang tidak ada.

Sekarang dua angka, "Liquid now" + "Waiting on the strategy", dengan
kalimat yang menyebut syaratnya. Definisinya tunggal (`splitPosition` di
lib/vaultAccount.ts) dan dipakai PositionPanel maupun
DepositWithdrawPanel: dua rumus yang menyimpang akan saling menyalahkan
di layar yang sama. Baris kedua hanya muncul kalau memang ada yang
tertahan (ambang 0,1%, kalau tidak ia jadi hiasan permanen sebesar debu
pembulatan ERC-4626).

Pemecahan itu DIMATIKAN saat halt, dan ini ketahuan dari uji bukan dari
membaca kode: ketika halt `maxWithdraw` = 0, jadi rumusnya melabeli

fix(contracts): tangani rate limit RPC pada fork test supaya CI berhenti flaky

CI merah dua run berturut-turut pada 31 Jul di `ExecuteTradeFork` dan
`PriceLib`, dengan pesan `Max retries exceeded HTTP error 429`. Jumlah test
yang gagal BERBEDA tiap run (3 lalu 2), dan rerun tanpa mengubah satu baris
pun langsung hijau. Jadi ini bukan regresi kode, melainkan RPC publik Coston2
yang menolak burst permintaan fork.

Bahayanya bukan sekadar merepotkan: CI yang merah tanpa ada yang salah melatih
orang mengabaikan warna merah, dan itu tepat sebelum penjurian.

Akar masalahnya ada dua lapis, dan lapis kedua yang membuat lapis pertama
tidak pernah bekerja:

1. Foundry membanjiri RPC tanpa menahan lajunya sendiri, lalu ditolak 429.
2. `[rpc_endpoints]` ditulis sebagai string biasa, sehingga TIDAK BISA
   membawa konfigurasi retry sama sekali. Lebih dari itu, kedua test mem-fork
   lewat URL MENTAH hasil `vm.envOr("RPC_URL_COSTON2", ...)`, bukan lewat
   alias — dan konfigurasi endpoint menempel pada ALIAS. Jadi seandainya pun
   retry sudah dikonfigurasi, ia akan dilewati tanpa peringatan apa pun.

Perbaikan:
- `[rpc_endpoints].coston2` jadi bentuk tabel dengan `compute_units_per_second
  = 50` (Foundry menahan lajunya sendiri, ini yang menyelesaikan akar masalah),
  plus `retries = 10` dan `retry_backoff = 1000` sebagai jaring pengaman untuk
  429 yang tetap lolos.
- Kedua fork test mem-fork lewat `vm.createSelectFork("coston2")`. Env var
  tetap dipakai, tapi hanya untuk memutuskan skip saat RPC tidak dikonfigurasi,
  sehingga `forge test` tanpa env tetap hijau seperti sebelumnya.

Blok fork SENGAJA tidak dipatok ke nomor blok tertentu. Memakai
`fork_block_number` akan menghidupkan cache RPC on-disk dan menghilangkan 429
sepenuhnya, tapi juga mematikan hal yang justru diuji di sini: bahwa integrasi
FTSO dan BlazeSwap masih bekerja terhadap Coston2 SEKARANG. Komentar di
ci.yml sudah menyatakan prinsipnya ("CI hijau harus berarti benar-benar
teruji"), jadi yang dibenahi lajunya, bukan cakupannya.

Verifikasi lokal: 91 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (8 di antaranya fork test),
`forge fmt --check` bersih, dan `forge config` mengonfirmasi retries/backoff/
CUPS benar-benar terbaca dari alias.

anggaran frame.

terjadi bola berhenti terbaca sebagai debu.

feat(A7): pemulihan strategi setelah rotasi kunci mesin TEE

Menutup cacat paling berbahaya di repo ini: rotasi kunci mesin membunuh
permanen setiap vault yang sudah menerima deposit, karena blob dienkripsi ke
kunci mesin dan setSealedStrategy beku setelah everDeposited. Bukan teori —
dua vault uji mati persis begitu 28 Jul.

PROTOCOL.md diubah DULU (aturan repo), lalu tiga sisi mengikuti:

(a) Enclave menandatangani (vault, blobHash, UNDECRYPTABLE) dengan kunci mesin,
    HANYA setelah percobaan dekripsi nyata gagal. Pembedaan yang menentukan:
    "aku tidak punya strategi" (sentinel, enclave restart) bukan hal yang sama
    dengan "aku sudah menerima blob ini dan tidak bisa membukanya". Hanya yang
    kedua boleh menghasilkan bukti. Dikembalikan sebagai status=1 + Data, bukan
    error: mengulanginya tidak akan pernah berhasil, dan menandainya gagal akan
    membuat keeper mengulang selamanya — pola yang menutupi B15 dulu.

(b) SealedVault.resealStrategy(newCiphertext, proofSignature). Tidak ada pihak
    yang bisa membukanya sendirian: strategist tidak memegang kunci mesin, dan
    mesin tidak memilih strategi pengganti. Bukti + ciphertext baru masuk dalam
    SATU transaksi, jadi tidak ada flag "vault terbuka" yang menganga di
    antaranya. Anti-replay tanpa nonce: blobHash mengikat bukti ke blob yang
    sedang berlaku, jadi sekali berhasil ia mati bersama blob-nya.

(c) Keeper mengenali bukti itu dan BERHENTI, menyebut blob mana yang mati.
    Tanpa ini keeper memoke vault mati selamanya (poke → sentinel → re-seal →
    ulang), membakar gas tiap siklus tanpa pernah konvergen. Keeper tidak bisa
    memperbaikinya sendiri: reseal butuh plaintext strategi, dan hanya
    strategist yang punya.

Verifikasi mesin TEE diekstrak jadi _requireActiveTeeMachine dan dipakai
bersama executeTrade — dua salinan aturan "siapa yang boleh dipercaya" adalah
cara paling mudah membuat keduanya menyimpang saat salah satu diperbaiki.

Typehash dipatok di TIGA implementasi (Solidity, enclave, keeper) lewat golden
vector baru, mengikuti pola yang sudah ada untuk order. Divergensi di sini
akan menolak setiap bukti yang sah, dan itu baru ketahuan saat vault sungguhan
sudah mati.

Residu diterima sadar dan dibuat terlihat, bukan disembunyikan: sesudah rotasi
